summary: Advance your HR expertise with our comprehensive Master - Advanced Diploma Program. Prepare for leadership roles in human resources management.
lede: Advanced HR courses help experienced HR professionals, including HR business partners and talent specialists, connect workforce decisions with business goals. Participants practise building strategic workforce plans, applying organization design and change-management methods, and developing competency-based performance, career-development and succession approaches for critical roles.
audienceIntro: This course is meticulously crafted for seasoned HR professionals seeking to elevate their strategic impact.
audience: Experienced HR Generalists with ambition to advance
HR specialists in Recruitment and Career Development
modules: Strategic HR and Human Capital Management
Managing your Talent - Career Development and Succession Planning
prerequisites: No specific prerequisites are required; however, a background in HR or related fields is recommended.
